blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippine men’s baseball team was defeated by Hong Kong, 7-5, in a placement round game marred by a rain delay on Saturday to conclude its campaign in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games. Disaster struck the Philippines in the fourth and fifth innings when Hong Kong erased a 2-0 deficit off ace pitcher Romeo Jasmin to take control of the contest held at Toyohashi Municipal Baseball Stadium. Chances of rallying in the final two frames went for naught as the Filipino batters would fall at the hands of the […]...
